losses.inverse_sampling_weights: untruncated Horvitz-Thompson weights normalized by their sum inside each likelihood term
losses.direct_active_survival_target: active observation event in the current year; weak/inactive observation and not-yet-observed states are non-active event states, not biochemical inactive labels

training.historical_internal_validation: deterministic 10% split by source_event_index; all rows from one source event stay together
training.refit: reinitialize and refit on all historical source events for the selected epoch count
training.precision: bfloat16 autocast on CUDA; float32 parameters and loss accumulation

scoring.timestamp_shuffled: same scoring as OFER_FULL using real development years after fitting with a fixed permutation of historical calendar-year inputs

metric_definitions.drug_macro_auprc: mean average precision over old-drug query groups containing at least one active event and at least one non-event candidate
metric_definitions.drug_macro_recall_at_20: mean fraction of active-event targets recovered in the top 20 over the same evaluable old-drug groups
metric_definitions.target_macro_auprc: mean average precision over target query groups containing at least one active event and at least one non-event candidate
metric_definitions.primary_selection_metric: equal-weight mean of drug-macro AUPRC and drug-macro Recall@20, averaged across both historical development windows
metric_definitions.uncertainty: 2000 paired bootstrap replicates over Bemis-Murcko scaffold clusters of old-drug queries

phase_a_gate_interpretation.full_exceeds_control_in_window: OFER_FULL is greater on either drug-macro AUPRC or Recall@20 without selecting a different metric per bootstrap replicate
phase_a_gate_interpretation.pooled_primary_gain: difference in the frozen primary selection metric averaged across both windows

claim_boundary: Passing Phase A would support this frozen joint mechanism for multiseed confirmation; it would not by itself establish full SOTA or literature novelty.
